annotations.title: Estimate the platform fee for an amount

description: Price discovery before quoting: given an amount in 6-decimal USDC units, returns the exact platform fee (0.5%, min $0.01), the maximum total the payer will be asked to authorize, the current fee schedule (fee_bps, min_fee, max_fee_cap) and an estimated gas figure. Free and read-only — the same fee quote_payment applies.

amount.description: Amount in smallest units (6 decimals for USDC), e.g. '2500000' = $2.50.

name: phantom_estimate_fee

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.
